name: code-judo
description: Strict quality review and architecture deepening: deep-review, deepen-architecture, codebase-design, and domain-modeling skills.

interface.shortDescription: Strict quality review and architecture deepening.
interface.longDescription: Code Judo reviews a diff for maintainability with an unusually strict bar, and scans a codebase for shallow modules worth deepening. It is ambitious about structure: it hunts for restructurings that delete complexity rather than rearrange it. Ships the deep-module design vocabulary and a domain-modeling discipline the other two skills speak.
defaultPrompt: Deep review this branch for structure, not bugs.
Is this abstraction earning its keep?
